card.name: Ends of mastocytosis and MAOIs
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long term: 'yt' in 'mastocytosis' (systemic mastocytosis) and 'Is' ending 'MAOIs' (monoamine oxidase inhibitors). It appears in drug-label warnings and dosing text.
